annotation.title_clean: 湖南省人民政府办公厅关于加快智能机器人产业发展的实施意见
annotation.title_en: Implementation Opinions of the General Office of the Hunan Provincial People's Government on Accelerating the Development of the Intelligent Robot Industry
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 湖南省人民政府办公厅 (General Office of the Hunan Provincial People's Government)
annotation.venue: 湖南省人民政府门户网站 (Hunan Provincial Government portal)
annotation.summary_en: Hunan provincial government opinion on accelerating the intelligent (embodied) robot industry. Sets revenue targets of 100 billion yuan by 2028 and 200 billion by 2030, and ten key projects covering lead firms, supply chain, innovation, application scenarios, standards, data and compute, talent and finance. It is industrial policy, with little safety or ethics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Targets: robot industry revenue above 100 billion yuan by 2028 and 200 billion yuan by 2030, with 5 then 10 lead enterprises.
Ten key projects, including lead-firm cultivation, supply-chain closure, industrial clusters and innovation platforms.
Opens application scenarios and supports about 20 scenarios and 30 innovative products each year.
Sets up a provincial robot standardization technical committee and a standards system.
Builds trusted data spaces, a robot compute pool and simulation testing platforms, and sets up a special working group and funding including a 10 billion yuan fund.
